description: Score bands shared by Core and the AI analytics service. A dimension average, or any other 0-100 score, becomes green, yellow or red here and nowhere else. Both runtimes read this file, so tuning the methodology after the pilot is an edit here plus a deploy of both services, not a code change in six places. Bands are inclusive integer ranges because every score reaching them is already rounded. They must cover 0-100 exactly once, in descending order.
